budget_enforcement.native_processes: individually bounded by the measurement instrument
budget_enforcement.search_cost: measured admission ceiling; not a preemptive whole-call deadline

baseline.external_abi: scalar-only C functions; resource and multiple-result functions are internal
runtime_assumptions: Linux LP64 target with 64-bit pointers and size_t
C calloc returns null or an initialized nonaliasing allocation of the requested size
C malloc returns null or a fresh nonaliasing allocation of the requested size; bytes are initialized before read or remain unobserved
C free accepts a live allocation from calloc or malloc, or null
abort terminates execution; no cleanup after traps is promised
native compiler, linker, loader, libc and host hardware are trusted

protocol.compile_boundary: LLVM emission plus compiler re-verification, tool identity, compilation, inspection and publication
protocol.cpu_clock_usage: informational; zero increments are retained, not evidence of zero CPU cost; wall time is the measured objective
protocol.ordering: baseline,candidate on even pair; candidate,baseline on odd pair
protocol.timed_boundary: C loop including indirect calls, allocator work, case iteration and checksum; no Python, compile or dlopen
protocol.warmup: one untimed correctness call per case and backend
